description: This file declares the InsecureJsonStorage class, which inherits from the Storage class and provides an interface for insecure JSON storage operations such as checking for keys, reading, writing, and existence checks within the secure environment of the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: InsecureJsonStorage
classes.description: A class providing insecure JSON storage functionalities within the secure environment namespace, inheriting from the Storage base class.

methods.name: InsecureJsonStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage with a specified file path.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in the storage.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data associated with a key from the storage.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified key in the storage.
